What Is an Anime Watchlist?

An anime watchlist is a personal collection of shows you plan to watch or have already completed. It helps you keep track of interesting titles instead of trying to remember every recommendation you discover.

Why Keep an Anime Watchlist?

With so many anime series available, it is easy to lose track of shows you want to explore. A watchlist gives you one convenient place to organise those titles and decide what to watch next.

Want to Watch and Watched Categories

Separating planned shows from completed ones makes your collection easier to manage. Use the Want to Watch category for future viewing and mark a series as Watched when you finish it.

How to Add Anime to Your Watchlist

Explore recommendations using the Bezels Quick Finder or Anime Quiz. When you find a title that interests you, use its Save to Watchlist option. The title will then appear in your personal collection.

Managing Your Collection

You can change an anime's watched status whenever you need to. You can also remove titles that are no longer relevant to your viewing plans.

Keep Discovering New Anime

Your watchlist can grow as you explore different genres and recommendations. Visit the Bezels Anime Finder and Anime Quiz to discover more titles for your collection.
